title: Signature Math Mapping — Run-Length Encoding (RLE)
description: How the Signature bitstring reads as Run-Length Encoding (RLE) (Compression). RLE compresses data by replacing runs of identical values with (count, value) pairs: 'AAABBC' -> '3A','2B','1C'.

fields.name: Run-Length Encoding (RLE)
fields.system: RLE compresses data by replacing runs of identical values with (count, value) pairs: 'AAABBC' -> '3A','2B','1C'.
fields.mapping: Compress the Signature bitstring's runs. The grid is mostly null space, so long zero-runs collapse dramatically — this is the honest reason the Signature archives so small.
apply: 2. Scan left to right; count each run of identical bits.
3. Write each run as count + bit (e.g. 5 ones -> '5x1').
4. Decode by expanding each run. Verify round-trip equality.

run_steps: Confirm every line prints PASS and the run ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
